data.memory_usage_summary: The facade-based monolith splitting memory informed the review of whether the private shim pattern (class delegates to extracted module functions) was correctly applied — specifically flagging that resolveTaskRuntime/getRuntimeDisplayName were extracted to lifecycle.ts but not wired back into the class via the _Fn shim pattern used by all other extracted functions.
data.summary:
* Reviewed PR #1897 — refactor of 3,036-line `task-dispatcher.ts` into 6 sibling modules (`prompts`, `log-streaming`, `metrics`, `webhook-callbacks`, `retry-logic`, `lifecycle`); all CI checks passed
  * New finding (code_quality): `resolveTaskRuntime`/`getRuntimeDisplayName` extracted to `lifecycle.ts` but not wired back into the class — class still has inline duplicates at lines 738–743, breaking the `_Fn` shim pattern used everywhere else
  * New finding (architecture): `lifecycle.ts` re-exports 3 unrelated symbols (`hasFatalExitCodeField`, `stripDockerHeaders`, `buildSystemPrompt`) at lines 130–131 that no consumer imports from this module — dead re-exports
  * New finding (code_quality): `checkForResult` v8 ignore uses `upstream` category for an if/else branch — CLAUDE.md explicitly prohibits this; should be `module-mock` with `execAsync` named as the testing blocker
  * Ongoing gap (test_quality): all 5 mandatory test scenarios from the issue requirements table remain absent — the state-machine behaviors (`dispatchTask` at capacity, `markTaskCompleted`, `streamTaskLogs`, `notifyCompletion`+retry, `scheduleRetry`) were not extracted and therefore cannot be unit-tested yet; prior reviews also noted this
